def encode(pairs):
    return '&'.join(str(k)+'='+str(v) for k,v in pairs)

import unittest

class Contract(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_contract(self):
        import query as m
        from urllib.parse import parse_qs
        self.assertEqual(parse_qs(m.encode([('x', ['a b', 'a&b']), ('q', '雪')])), {'x': ['a b', 'a&b'], 'q': ['雪']})
        self.assertEqual(m.encode([]), '')
